world.era: Victorian late 19th-century (1897): Transylvanian Carpathians, Whitby coast, and imperial London
world.setting: Castle Dracula in the Carpathian mountains, misty gothic Whitby port, Dr. Seward's Carfax asylum, Victorian drawing rooms, and legal offices across London
world.register: gothic techno-thriller, bureaucratic investigation, epistemological horror, Victorian administrative collation

dracula.name: Count Dracula
dracula.role: ancient Transylvanian noble and predatory biological monopoly invading London via real estate and maritime loopholes
dracula.look: an aristocratic pale man in his early fifties with sharp aquiline features, cold piercing eyes, swept-back iron-grey hair, heavy silver moustache, dressed in high-collared Victorian black frock coat and dark woollen cape

jonathan.name: Jonathan Harker
jonathan.role: earnest young English solicitor's clerk who discovers Dracula's true nature and audits the vampire's movements
jonathan.look: a tidy English gentleman in his late twenties with neat sandy-brown parted hair, anxious intelligent grey eyes, wearing a dark charcoal wool three-piece suit with high stiff collar and silk cravat

mina.name: Mina Harker
mina.role: schoolmistress and analytical mastermind whose cross-indexed dossiers, shorthand, and reverse hypnosis dismantle Dracula
mina.look: a poised determined twenty-six-year-old woman with pinned-up dark auburn hair, thoughtful brown eyes, wearing an austere high-necked dark navy Victorian day dress with crisp white collar and lace cuffs

helsing.name: Abraham Van Helsing
helsing.role: Dutch polymath doctor and philosopher bridging advanced medicine and arcane folklore to coordinate the hunt
helsing.look: an authoritative broad-shouldered man in his late fifties with receding iron-grey hair, penetrating blue eyes behind wire spectacles, bushy eyebrows, dressed in a tailored dark tweed overcoat and wool waistcoat

seward.name: Dr. John Seward
seward.role: earnest superintendent of the Purfleet lunatic asylum who records patient Renfield and the vampire hunt on wax cylinders
seward.look: a serious thoughtful physician in his early thirties with dark brown sideburns, tired strained eyes, wearing a dark brown tailored frock coat, dark vest and physician's pocket watch chain

renfield.name: R. M. Renfield
renfield.role: asylum patient whose zoophagous consumption of flies, spiders, and birds mirrors Dracula's metabolic life-absorption
renfield.look: an intense dishevelled man in his late forties with erratic greying hair, wild manic eyes, hollow cheeks, wearing a rumpled grey institutional asylum jacket and collarless canvas shirt

lucy.name: Lucy Westenra
lucy.role: aristocratic debutante whose somnambulism and gradual vampiric infection expose Victorian somatic vulnerability
lucy.look: a delicate pale twenty-year-old woman with golden blonde curls, vacant feverish blue eyes, wearing a flowing white Victorian nightgown with high lace trim

quincey.name: Quincey Morris
quincey.role: wealthy adventurous American hunter from Texas who finances the expedition and delivers the fatal heart strike
quincey.look: a tall sunburnt athletic man in his late twenties with dark short hair, steady grey eyes, wearing a rugged brown leather travelling coat, wide-brimmed felt hat and sturdy leather holster

library.look: a grand gloomy gothic library in Castle Dracula lined with ancient stone walls and tall oak shelves packed with modern English books and maps

bedroom.look: a shadowy Victorian bedchamber with tall drapes, garlic flowers strung across the windows, and an ornate four-poster bed

office.look: a cluttered London administrative office with rolltop desks, stacks of legal parchment, rail timetables, and a typewriter surrounded by phonograph cylinders

room.look: a stone-walled examination room in Dr. Seward's asylum with barred high windows and iron-frame medical furnishings

shore.look: a wind-battered gothic harbour at Whitby beneath crumbling abbey ruins, shrouded in thick sea fog and crashing surf

street.look: a cobblestone gaslit London street slick with rain, lined with brick facades and horse-drawn carriages

objects.why: Jonathan's shorthand diary, Mina's typed transcripts, and Dr. Seward's phonograph records that constitute the evidence dossier
Real estate deeds, lease contracts, and legal mandates used by Dracula to infiltrate London and by the hunters to audit him
English history and rail timetable directories studied by Dracula in Transylvania and consulted by the hunters
The locked portals of Castle Dracula and the barred windows of Carfax estate and Seward's asylum
Heavy iron keys representing captive enclosure in Transylvania and access to the Carfax earth boxes
The supernatural tempest that steers the doomed schooner Demeter into Whitby harbor
The North Sea and the Black Sea rivers over which Dracula travels as cargo
The protective barrier of consecrated wafers, garlic garlands, and bureaucratic documentation

spine.claim: Dracula structures his invasion as a legal and administrative property transaction, turning Jonathan Harker into an unwilling tutor.
The Demeter logbook and Lucy's medical collapse prove that Dracula travels through the blind spots of modern transport and medicine.
Mina Harker transforms disparate diaries, phonograph wax, and train timetables into a coordinated analytical database.
Forensic accounting tracks down Dracula's distributed earth boxes and cuts off his metropolitan escape routes.
Steam engines, telegraph lines, and administrative speed intercept Dracula before he reaches his fortress, proving the triumph of modern collation.
